name: Mercury
description: The closest planet to the Sun, Mercury is a small rocky planet with extreme temperature variations. Named after the Roman messenger god.

name: Venus
description: Venus is the second planet from the Sun and the hottest planet in our solar system due to its thick atmosphere of carbon dioxide. Named after the Roman goddess of love.

name: Earth
description: Earth is our home planet, the third from the Sun. It's the only known planet in the universe to harbor life. Features oceans, continents, and a breathable atmosphere.

name: Mars
description: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun, known as the Red Planet due to its iron oxide-rich surface. It has polar ice caps and evidence of past water activity.

name: Jupiter
description: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system, a gas giant with at least 95 moons. Famous for its Great Red Spot and powerful magnetosphere. Named after the Roman king of gods.

name: Saturn
description: Saturn is famous for its spectacular ring system made of ice and rock particles. A gas giant with at least 146 moons. Named after the Roman god of agriculture.

name: Uranus
description: Uranus is an ice giant with a unique tilted axial rotation (almost on its side). It has faint rings and at least 27 moons. Named after the Greek personification of the heavens.

name: Neptune
description: Neptune is the windiest planet in our solar system with speeds up to 2,100 km/h. An ice giant with at least 16 moons and faint rings. Named after the Roman god of the sea.
